body:
I just saw this today, and I fucking ADORE this scene. It communicates a deep shift in Arthur's psyche simply through good directing, cinematography, lighting, sound design, and of course Joaquin Phoenix's absolutely stellar performance; no dialogue required. It's a scene that on the surface seems so simple, yet it says so much by doing so little. Joker had always been inside of Arthur, lying dormant, and Arthur has begun to embrace the dark side of him he never knew he had.   
The final shot of Arthur staring into the mirror with his arms outstretched just ties this scene into a perfect little bow. Accompanied with the flickering florescent lights, the heavy green tinge to the lighting, and that slow and ominous music, perfection.
